description: VN 'nghiên cứu về' transfer: learners calque 've'=about onto the transitive verb research ('research about cancer'). Rule en-vietlish-research-about drops 'about' (mirrors en-step6-discuss-about) ONLY when research is a VERB. A negative lookbehind blocks do-support and determiners/quantifiers/possessives so the noun sense ('do research about X', 'some research about X') is left untouched.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. 'about' is correct when research is a NOUN. V1 fires only when research is a VERB; the negative lookbehind locks the noun sense. Negatives: already-correct 'I research cancer', a non-research 'about' phrase, a different verb ('read about'), and the do-support noun case 'I do research about cancer' (must abstain -> would otherwise wrongly become 'do research it').

negative.notes: No research verb at all -> must not fire.
Different verb 'read' (about is correct) -> must not fire.
do-support: 'research' is a NOUN here, 'about' is correct. Lookbehind must block; otherwise the rule would wrongly produce 'do research cancer'. (Precision lock.)

negative.input: I will do research about it
negative.expectedCorrection: I will do research about it.
negative.notes: do-support noun sense again -> must abstain.
